---
title: "Class Notes for 10-20"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(nflreadr)
library(tidyverse)
fantasy2026 <- load_player_stats(2026, summary_level = "reg") |>
  dplyr::filter(position %in% c("RB","WR","TE")) |>
  select(player_display_name,position,games,
         carries,rushing_yards,rushing_tds,
         receptions,targets,receiving_yards,receiving_tds,
         fantasy_points_ppr)|>
  as.data.frame() 
glimpse(fantasy2026)
```

```{r}
library(rpart)
library(rattle)
fantasy_tree=rpart(fantasy_points_ppr~.,data=fantasy2026[,2:11])
fancyRpartPlot(fantasy_tree)
```

Pruning

```{r}
plotcp(fantasy_tree,upper="splits")
```

PLot looks good (x-val error goes down) but say we want to prune to 5 splits

```{r}
fantasy_tree$cptable
```

```{r}
fantasy_prune=prune(fantasy_tree,cp=0.025)
fancyRpartPlot(fantasy_prune)
```

```{r}
table(fantasy_tree$where)
```

```{r}
fantasy2026$player_display_name[fantasy_tree$where==15]
```
